title: Tracking plan
description: Event names, their properties and an optional funnel order. Checks that need to look across the file (a required property must be declared, a funnel step must be a declared event) are made by the eqg validator, not by this schema.

funnel.description: Event names in the order a user is expected to reach them.

required.description: Names of properties that every event of this name must carry.

enum.description: The only values allowed. Each must match the declared type.

pii.description: True when the property is expected to carry personal data. PII-shaped values are reported in any property that does not set this.

maxDistinct.description: Upper bound on the number of distinct values seen in a stream. Not allowed with enum or on a boolean.
